title.zh: 为什么有些音放在一起好听
title.en: Why Some Notes Sound Good Together

desc.zh: 一个音其实是一叠泛音；两个音的泛音撞在一起会拍、会发糙。把粗糙加起来，简单的频率比自己冒出来；再把五度一个个叠上去，就明白钢琴为什么一个八度是十二个键。八个可以听、可以拖动的模型。
desc.en: A note is really a stack of harmonics, and when two notes' harmonics collide they beat and turn rough. Add up the roughness and the simple frequency ratios appear on their own; stack fifths one by one and you see why a piano has twelve keys to the octave. Eight models you can hear and drag.

desc.zh: 一个乐音是基音加整数倍的泛音；音高跟着重复周期走，音色由各泛音的多少决定，去掉基音音高也不变。
desc.en: A musical note is a fundamental plus whole-number harmonics; pitch follows the repetition period, timbre the harmonics' sizes, and removing the fundamental leaves the pitch.

zh: 为什么同一个音钢琴和小提琴听起来不一样
en: why does the same note sound different on piano and violin

title.zh: 简单整数比与重合的泛音

desc.zh: 八度 2:1、五度 3:2：频率比越简单，两个音重合的泛音越多。
desc.en: Octave 2:1, fifth 3:2: the simpler the frequency ratio, the more harmonics two notes share.

zh: 为什么八度听起来像同一个音
en: why is an octave double the frequency
why do octaves sound the same

desc.zh: 两个靠近的频率以差频起伏；差再大变成粗糙感，Plomp–Levelt 曲线，峰值位置随音区变。
desc.en: Two close frequencies swell at their difference; further apart they turn rough. The Plomp–Levelt curve, whose peak moves with register.

zh: 为什么两个音差一点会抖
en: why do two close notes wobble

desc.zh: 把两个乐音所有泛音对的粗糙度加起来，低谷自己落在 6/5、5/4、4/3、3/2、5/3、2/1 上。
desc.en: Sum the roughness of every pair of partials of two notes and the dips fall on 6/5, 5/4, 4/3, 3/2, 5/3 and 2/1 by themselves.

zh: 为什么有些音放在一起好听
en: why do some notes sound good together
why do some chords sound good

title.zh: 音色决定哪些音程平滑
title.en: Timbre decides which intervals are smooth

desc.zh: 换成拉伸的或金属棒的泛音，不协和曲线的低谷就搬家：协和依赖频谱。
desc.en: Switch to stretched or metal-bar partials and the dips move: consonance depends on the spectrum.

zh: 为什么钟声和弦听着怪
en: why do bells sound odd in chords

title.zh: 五度相生律与毕达哥拉斯音差

desc.zh: 一个个叠纯五度得到五声、七声、十二声音阶；十二个五度比七个八度多 23.46 音分。
desc.en: Stacking pure fifths gives five-, seven- and twelve-note scales; twelve fifths overshoot seven octaves by 23.46 cents.

en: where does the pentatonic scale come from
where does the major scale come from

title.zh: 为什么一个八度是十二个音
title.en: Why twelve notes to the octave

desc.zh: log₂(3/2) 的连分数近似 7/12：在键数不多的切法里，12 等分的五度最准；5、7、12、29、41、53 依次刷新纪录。
desc.en: The continued-fraction approximation 7/12 of log₂(3/2): among small divisions, 12 gets the fifth nearly right; 5, 7, 12, 29, 41, 53 set the records.

zh: 为什么钢琴一个八度十二个键
en: why does a piano have twelve keys per octave

desc.zh: 平均律让每个调都一样，代价是大三度偏高 13.69 音分，在中音区每秒拍约 10 次；纯律一换调就出狼五度。
desc.en: Equal temperament makes every key alike at the cost of thirds 13.69 cents wide, beating about ten times a second in the middle register; just intonation hits wolf fifths when you change key.

zh: 为什么钢琴不是完全准的
en: why is a piano slightly out of tune

desc.zh: 粗糙和融合在不同文化里相近，喜不喜欢协和却不普遍（Tsimane' 研究）；世界上还有许多别的律制。
desc.en: Roughness and fusion look similar across cultures, but liking consonance is not universal (the Tsimane' studies); many other tuning systems exist.

zh: 为什么别的国家的音乐听起来不一样
en: why does music from other cultures sound different
